EMAIL_PATTERN = /\A[A-Z0-9!#$%&'*+\/?=^_`{|}~-]+(?:\.[A-Z0-9!#$%&'*+\/?=^_`{|}~-]+)*@(?:[A-Z0-9](?:[A-Z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Z0-9])?\.)+[A-Z0-9](?:[A-Z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Z0-9])?\z/i

# Returns true when +value+ has the basic shape of an email address.
# This checks syntax only; it does not verify that the address exists.
def valid_email?(value)
  value.is_a?(String) && EMAIL_PATTERN.match?(value)
end
